name: doc-compression
description: Documentation compression achieving 5-7x reduction with 95-99% fidelity
author: Cerebro Team

tools.name: doc_compress_file
tools.description: Compress a single documentation file using specified strategy. Achieves 5-7x compression while maintaining 95-99% information fidelity. Supports multiple strategies: hierarchical-yaml (default, 6.6x), dense-notation (7x), adjacency-lists (6x), table-compression (5x), tiered-structure (3-8x), hybrid (7-8x).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to compress

outputPath.description: Custom output path (optional, defaults to COMPRESSED-{filename}.yaml)

tools.name: doc_compress_folder
tools.description: Compress all documentation files in a folder. Can combine multiple files into a single knowledge base or compress individually.

folderPath.description: Absolute path to the folder to compress

combineFiles.description: Combine all files into single output

includePattern.description: Glob pattern for files to include (default: **/*.md)

excludePattern.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude

tools.name: doc_scan_compress
tools.description: Auto-scan project for documentation and compress with optimal strategy selection. Analyzes content to recommend best compression approach.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project root

autoDetectStrategy.description: Automatically detect optimal strategy based on content
